18:12096-1987 

3. Material — The hexagonal socket screw plugs shall be manufactured from suitable low carbon steel 
with a minimum tensile strength of 500 MPa. 

4. Surface Protection — Hexagon socket screw plugs with parallel screw threads shall be phosphated 
to Class A2 of 18:3618-1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection 
against corrosion', or any other surface protection, for example, zinc plating as agreed to between the 
user and the manufacturer. 

5. Designation — A hexagon screw plug with parallel screw thread with </. = G 1/8. undercut type A 
as per 18:8805 (Part 1 )-1978 'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil hydraulic 
systems : Part 1 General', shall be designated as: 

Hex Socket Screw Plug G1/8 IS: 12096 A. 

6.1 When undercut type B is used, the designation shall be: 

Hex Socket Screw Plug G1/8 18:12096 B. 

6. Marking — The cartons containing the hexagon socket screw plugs shall be marked with the 
designation and the manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

6.1 Certification i\/larl(ing — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

These hexagon socket screw plugs may be used to plug holes with a parallel internal screw 
thread along with sealing rings as per 18:3175-1974 'Specification for sealing washers for pipe unions 
(first revision )\ The related standard on sealing plug is 18:9645-1980 'Specification for threaded 
plugs'. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from DIN 908-1983 
'Hexagon socket screw plugs with parallel screw thread', issued by Deutsches InstitUt for 
Normung ( DIN ). 



Printed at Britannia Calendar Mfg Co. Calcutta. India
